headline: Casa Piva / B.E Architecture
context: Casa Piva is discreetly sited off a quiet suburban laneway in Malvern East . Its prevailing sense of privacy and intimacy is created through a series of inwardly oriented courtyards that surround the house, forming a cocoon at its interface with its neighbours.
